rewrites.//: GitHub Pages has no rewrites, so /puzzle/<id> was served as the 404 page WITH a 404 status. Every puzzle the app shares is one of these links, and link previews in Messages, WhatsApp and Slack skip a 404. Here the same file is served with a 200.

headers.//: Both files are extensionless, so the type has to be stated or the OS rejects the deep-link proof.
